Tiered rule (stable category): +20.0% > 15% threshold -> significant tier. Proposal baseline: triggers alert.

Hand calculation: Day 60 linear phase is 0.60. expectedToDate = 100,000 * 0.60 = 60,000. actual = 55,000. variancePct = (55,000 - 60,000) / 60,000 = -5,000 / 60,000 = -0.0833 (-8.33%). Derivation: Cumulative actual spend did not keep pace with linear schedule, so expectedToDate caught up. Because variancePct is negative (-8.33%), tier naturally returns to normal. Alert resolves.

Hand calculation: Day 100 linear phase is 1.00. expectedToDate = 100,000. actual = 98,000. variancePct = (98,000 - 100,000) / 100,000 = -2,000 / 100,000 = -0.0200 (-2.00%). Negative variance yields normal tier in both tiered and baseline modes.
